name: shotcraft-marker-title
title: 马克笔关键词
description: Emphasize one short keyword in a title with a quick human marker gesture.
author: WeiYihao; iPolloWork integration

upstream.adaptation: Remotion frame interpolation ported to paused HyperFrames/GSAP with original pure easing functions; absolute cues reanchored to narration. Demo skeletons replaced by real content variables and theme tokens. Not a pixel-identical native Remotion render.

ai.instructions: Emphasize one short keyword in a title with a quick human marker gesture. Not a correction or negation; do not combine the underline with simultaneous keyword bounce or camera movement.

events.action: Draw a textured marker beneath the measured keyword

useWhen: Emphasize one short keyword in a title with a quick human marker gesture.
avoidWhen: Not a correction or negation; do not combine the underline with simultaneous keyword bounce or camera movement.

inputRules.prefix: Leading title text, at most 8 characters.
inputRules.keyword: Exactly one key term, 1–6 characters; its measured width owns the underline.
inputRules.suffix: Following title text, at most 8 characters.

readingOrder: Draw a textured marker beneath the measured keyword

cueBindings.title: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Settle the title before emphasis. Do not estimate from text length.
cueBindings.underline: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Draw a textured marker beneath the measured keyword. Do not estimate from text length.

fallback.overflow: Split at a semantic boundary or choose a suitable recipe. Do not shrink or truncate text.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve required content and real assets; report a gap instead of using placeholder graphics.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured phrases while preserving original movement ratios and final hold. Split the scene if it does not fit.
fallback.inapplicable: Select another proven recipe; with recipes-only policy, report the library gap rather than author custom graphics.

example.narration: 先理解机制，再判断好坏。

acceptance: Every action changes the real target and reverse seeking restores the same picture.
Use actual content, measured fonts and validated project-local media.
Preserve original movement functions, geometry and ordering; the final state remains readable.
usage.intent: 像手工批注一样划出短标题的一个重点词，让观众先读到真正的焦点。
